steps.name: Bison
steps.text: The shots are coming from above? Are they up on the overpass?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: How high is the angle of attack? Where could they be shooting from?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Doesn't matter. First I've got to——!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Nng——!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oof!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I- I'm okay. What's this...? It's sticky...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: A Sauin candle? Real lucky these were here...
You got one stuck in your horn too.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh? Oh, thanks. I guess I better yank it... out——!
Don't move, candle boy.
Quiet. Take cover behind that crate.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We lost Fronzo's signal. Oughta be around here somewhere!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is here too. Tell the boss as soon as you spot the target.
You can come out.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, okay...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I appreciate your help, but you really don't wanna get mixed up in this. You better go somewhere safe.
I'd love to. It's been a while since I had a trip to Lungmen. But a job's a job...
Considering how I found you, I'm guessing your deal with Penguin Logistics isn't going so well?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...you could say that.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Err, who are you, exactly? I get the feeling you're not a typical passer-by.
Calm down. Let's just say I'm not your enemy.
Whoops, they're coming back. Hide.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Mamma mia! Those Penguin bastards got Fronzo! What're we gonna do?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: That Bison kid's all alone. This could be our big break.

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Can we really just yoink him in the middle of downtown Lungmen?

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Mr. Capone says as long as we do it nice and quiet-like, hold off on the guns and bombs, Lungmen won't make a fuss.

steps.name: Mafioso B
steps.text: Nobody's gonna go looking in those filthy old alleyways, eh?

steps.name: Mafioso A
steps.text: Then we'll be the backup, you find the kid. Capiche?
Well, we can't stay here. Let's get going.
Let's see... over there. Let's say hello.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Ya find Bison yet, baws?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I'm wearin' shades, not binoculars. Gimme some space!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Aight... I see 'im. Waving at me.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Well let's go get him, then come back and ask this guy what they're up to.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mmmf—— Mmmh——

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Nah.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Looks like our lucky little Bison had a smooth landing. He can get hisself back here.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Um... he took a forty-foot drop onto a smooth landin'? How's that?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: And the bad guys are kinda hunting for him. You sure we shouldn't go get him?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: She's got him.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...She's back?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Exusiai, stay focused.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: There they are! We gotta spring Fronzo!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Sigh. There's just no end to you people.
I think we lost them.
So what's Texas and the girls gotten themselves into this time? Who are they fighting now?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Can I really trust you?
I guess I better introduce myself. I'm Mostima. A Messenger for Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I think that makes me your colleague, for now. I usually work alone though.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...Mostima. I've heard that name from my father before.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (Not to mention a Sankta with black horns... the rumors were true. Better not ask about them though...)

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Oh...? Good things I hope?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Erm... how should I say...? Just baseless rumors...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: And after you saved me like that, I have no reason to doubt you. Sorry.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Don't worry about it. You got nothing to apologize for.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Thanks... Now we should share our intelligence... although I'm still pretty confused.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Basically, Penguin Logistics is in some kind of conflict with an arm of the Siracusan mafia.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right. Got it.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Huh? You got it already?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: I don't need any more. You need to stop thinking so much. Trust your instincts. That's the Penguin Logistics way.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh. So the trick is to just stop thinking, huh...?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: They're a very special bunch. Common sense doesn't really work here.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...What about you, Mostima?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Are you always this direct with people?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I- I think so.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: We need to get moving.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Follow me.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Eyo, you found the target yet?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: There's too many people. Hey, I'm walkin' here!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: C'mon, let's check somewhere else.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...I don't think they saw us.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Just keep going like this, and we'll figure out a way to meet back up with the others.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Hm.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Wh- what is it?

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: If we keep going like this, we'll end up...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: G- getting caught by the mob?!

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: So that's where it was. It's been so many years since I've been back to Lungmen. All the signs are different.

steps.name: Mostima
steps.text: Right... are you hungry? I'm trying to decide between matcha and chocolate.
